dict.string: Dark palette ported from the "Charcoal Rose" variant of ZerafinaCSS's "neos" AO3 workskin family (MIT licensed); light palette inspired by intothisshadow's "Moonlit Wisteria" AO3 site skin (values reimplemented independently, no license grant relied on). Merged into one auto light/dark theme with a shared shape language and unified typography.
